# Master Services Agreement CON-2026-021: Bluepeak Travel

## 4. Service levels
Northwind Pay guarantees 99.95% monthly uptime for Payments API.

## 5. Service credits
If monthly uptime falls below the target, the customer receives a service credit of 10% of that month's fees.
